decision: Reuse four existing worktrees/output bases and preserve all original results. One baseline writer then independent B reader avoids two duplicate ~430MB cold packs; subsequent readers, edits and reverts run with two concurrent servers. No timing comparison between sequential seed and paired phases.
discarded: New large worktree/outputbase clones or two redundant cold baseline packs exceed the remaining host-volume reserve. Do not disable storage preflight.
acceptance: Current binary, exact independent controls, native analysis hits, no invalidation deadlines, memory/time samples, source restoration, legacy data preserved, collection then rebuild/reuse.
